localChanges: `tools/registry-profile.js` counts `EntityRegistry.entries()` calls and copied elements per registry class, for the same reason `rule-profile.js` exists: a CPU profile attributes all of this to one frame and cannot say whose registry it is.

It contradicted #42's guess twice over. `RuleRegistry` was **59 calls** — the per-rule-type cache works, and re-sorting 924 rules was not happening. What it found instead was a plain `EntityRegistry` at 204,552 calls copying 490 million elements, 2,400 per call, which is exactly the tile count of a 60x40 world: `World.get(x, y)` copying every tile to index one of them.
98.5% of all registry copying in a thirty-turn run, now 7.5M elements down from 498M.
